constraints.C1: Never use or recommend features that are in preview — GA features only, no exceptions.
constraints.C2: All data processing must stay in EU regions — no cross-geo features, no consent to data leaving the EU.
constraints.C3: Automation must authenticate as a service principal only — no user-delegated or interactive auth flows.
constraints.C4: Capacity is fixed at F8 — never recommend anything that requires a larger Fabric SKU.
constraints.C5: The environment is air-gapped for compliance — solutions must not call external services or public web APIs.

placebo_constraint: All report theme colours must come from the corporate palette (hex values starting #1E or #C4).
